changelog: Mod sharing v0.5.10: Create-a-Mod's Import/Export tab is real — Export any installed mod to one MOD1- share code (full payload + hook scripts + voxel assets, mod-only, no key/secrets); Import runs the same validation + approval, with Replace / Keep Both (block mods _copy, script mods _2). Duplicate-block_id Keep Both dead end fixed — copies get their block_id rewritten and re-validated, so original and copy load side by side.
